title: Morning Robotics Scan
report:
## HFlow: open-source SDK for scalable multimodal robotics data pipelines

### The Breakthrough
The core idea treats each recording episode as an MCAP container and orchestrates processing steps as Airflow DAGs, automatically generating provenance metadata and a Parquet catalog; quality checks and enrichments are plain Python functions that plug in without rewriting code, enabling efficient reads for training.

### The Caveats
Scalability is untested beyond a single local demo, with no benchmark or baseline comparison.

## NVIDIA Agent Skills: portable toolkits for coding agents

### The Breakthrough
The repo defines standardized, portable instruction sets (“skills”) that encode best‑practice usage of NVIDIA products and expose them to AI agents via the skills CLI; the catalog syncs daily from product repos, supports multiple agents, and currently has 3,288 stars, enabling agents to run GPU‑accelerated simulation and data‑frame tasks end‑to‑end.

### The Caveats
No performance or usability evaluation of the skills on actual agents is provided.

## Synaptic Harmony: multi-agent Q-learning swarm foraging simulator

### The Breakthrough
The environment implements pure‑NumPy distributed Q‑learning where each forager maintains its own Q‑table, learns via epsilon‑greedy exploration with decaying rates, and operates in a dynamic grid world with resource regeneration and moving obstacles; episodes run under 200 ms on a laptop and an animated dashboard logs rewards and Q‑table snapshots.

### The Caveats
It provides no comparison to existing multi‑agent RL baselines, leaving performance advantages unverified.

## Pion: platform for autonomous business agents

### The Breakthrough
Pion offers persistent agents with integrated access to email, phone, banking, and browsing tools, enabling end‑to‑end operation of a company without human intervention; deployments on vending‑machine and small retail pilots show Claude Opus 4 can turn a profit in simple scenarios.

### The Caveats
The claim to run any company autonomously is unsubstantiated beyond a single vending machine and small pilots, with no evidence on complex enterprises.

## Siri Model Delegation: swapping Siri AI for Claude or ChatGPT

### The Breakthrough
The “Model Delegation” mechanism lets an external LLM such as Claude appear as a Siri extension, and Model Manager Services can replace Apple’s server‑side Siri model with a GPT‑15.6 model, feeding the native planner prompt and tool definitions so it can invoke system tools and return results through Siri’s voice UI.

### The Caveats
The demonstration is short and lacks quantitative metrics or comparisons to existing Siri implementations.

### Priority
HFlow is the best starting point because it provides a concrete, open‑source pipeline that immediately lets robotics teams turn raw MCAP logs into clean, indexed datasets for training, addressing a common bottleneck in robot learning.

### One action
Clone the HFlow repo and run its example to convert a recent MCAP recording into a Parquet catalog for your own experiments.
